Anime film still, hand-painted cel style, cinematic lighting, rich color, clean linework, vertical 9:16 frame, night, steady rain, dense neon city in pink and teal. Wide shot of a flat wet rooftop. a young courier girl in a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down, short black bob haircut, a dark green messenger bag across her body sprints into the frame from the lower left, mid-stride, splashing through puddles, looking back over her shoulder. On the left side of the rooftop stands a tall wooden water tower with a metal ladder up its side. On the right edge of the roof, a taut steel zipline cable runs from a short pole out across the street. In the background center, a small rooftop stairwell hut with a red metal door. The rooftop is otherwise empty.

Wide shot of a flat wet rooftop. a young courier girl in a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down, short black bob haircut, a dark green messenger bag across her body stands in the center foreground, seen from behind at a three-quarter angle, cornered and catching her breath. On the left side of the rooftop stands a tall wooden water tower with a metal ladder up its side. On the right edge of the roof, a taut steel zipline cable runs from a short pole out across the street. In the background center, a small rooftop stairwell hut with a red metal door. At the far back edge of the roof, three ninjas dressed all in black with red scarves crouch on the ledge, watching her, motionless. The lower quarter of the frame is wet rooftop with puddles and reflections.

Anime film still, hand-painted cel style, cinematic lighting, rich color, clean linework, vertical 9:16 frame, night, steady rain, dense neon city in pink and teal. a young courier girl in a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down, short black bob haircut, a dark green messenger bag across her body crouches on a narrow metal catwalk high above the street, seen from behind at a three-quarter angle, in front of a giant glowing billboard with abstract pink and blue light shapes and no words. Below on the right, an elevated subway train with lit windows passes on its track. On the left, a tall red and white radio antenna tower with a ladder. Far away on the left end of the catwalk, three ninjas dressed all in black with red scarves stand still in a row, watching her. The lower quarter of the frame is the steel catwalk grating, wet with rain.
